description: Welcome to your Xxl haven of peace in the heart of the capital. Located on rue Greffulhe, in a very central, quiet and discreet street, this unique combination consists of two strictly identical luxury apartments, located on the same landing on the same floor.Fully air-conditioned, this ensemble combines Parisian elegance with absolute comfort.The spaceWelcome to your Xxl haven of peace in the heart of the capital. Located on rue Greffulhe, in a very central, quiet and discreet street, this unique combination consists of two strictly identical luxury apartments, located on the same landing on the same floor.Fully air-conditioned, this ensemble combines Parisian elegance with absolute comfort. It is the ideal solution for very large families, professional stays or groups of friends of up to 14 people who wish to travel together whilst maintaining their privacy (2 independent entrance doors on the same landing).From the very entrance, you will be seduced by the nobility of the materials and the care taken with details. By renting this combo, you benefit from double the comfort:2 magnificent convivial dining rooms, each opening onto a modern fully equipped American kitchen, perfect for sharing meals after a day of sightseeing. A large sofa is available in each living room to accommodate 2 additional guests in total (1 per apartment).6 elegant bedrooms (3 in each apartment), each equipped with high-end bedding and a smart television for your moments of relaxation.4 contemporary and refined bathrooms (2 per apartment) for everyone's comfort.Signed by the renowned interior architects Katz Architecture Studio, these apartments reflect their unique design approach: elegance, refinement and attention to detail.A prestigious and ultra-central addressYou are only a few steps away
